name: Wrapper for the Tapestry Scroll Mingling of Clear and Muddy Water at the Junction of the Jing and Wei Rivers
material: Silk and metal thread: tapestry weave, painted with ink and colors
summary: The cloth to wrap the tapestry scroll, Mingling of Clear and Muddy Water at the Junction of the Jing and Wei Rivers, CMA 1915.618.a, features a dragon, emblem of imperial power, on an imperial yellow ground.
